entities.name: Marcel Deslauriers
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcel Deslauriers was a Canadian/Québécois international draughts player. In 1956 he became the only North American, male or female, to win Draughts World Championship. A tournament in Canada was named in his honor and a book was written on him and his strategies.
